title: EssentialPlus1
description: EssentialPlus is an all-in-one Minecraft Essentials plugin designed for Paper servers. It provides the most commonly used utility commands and server management features in a lightweight, easy-to-use package.
body:
Features

* Player utilities: /heal, /feed, /fly
* Gamemode commands: /gmc, /gms, /gma, /gmsp
* Teleportation system: /spawn, /setspawn, /home, /sethome, /warp, /setwarp
* TPA requests: /tpa, /tpaccept, /tpdeny
* Staff tools: /vanish, /clearchat, /broadcast
* Permission-based access control
* Customizable messages and configuration files
* Optimized for modern Paper servers
* Simple setup with powerful features

EssentialPlus combines the most important server commands into one reliable plugin, helping server owners reduce plugin clutter while giving players and staff the tools they need for everyday gameplay and management.
